q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for **August 26, 2026** (tomorrow from the reference date of August 25, 2026). Resolution occurs essentially immediately after the earnings announcement and analyst call. **~24 hours until resolution.**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for **forward guidance** given at the Q2 FY2027 earnings release (August 26), which means guidance for **Q3 FY2027** (the next quarter).

Based on the research provided:
- **Consensus analyst estimate for Q3 FY2027**: $103.8 billion
- **Bank of America (bullish case)**: $107–108 billion
- **NVIDIA's historical guidance approach**: The company has been relatively conservative with official guidance while Wall Street runs ahead with estimates

NVIDIA's official guidance typically comes with a ±2% margin (as evidenced by the Q2 guidance of $91.0B ±2%). If they guide to consensus (~$103.8B), the range would be approximately $101.7B–$105.9B.

**Most likely outcome: NVIDIA guides to approximately $103–104 billion for Q3 FY2027** (or possibly slightly higher if they feel emboldened by strong demand and China revenue upside).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Conservative positioning**: If NVIDIA wants to beat guidance badly (their historical preference), they might guide lower—perhaps toward $100–102 billion
- **Macro headwinds**: Any indication of slower enterprise spending could lead to more cautious guidance
- **Execution concerns**: If there are supply chain or fulfillment challenges, guidance could be conservative
- **Typical pattern**: NVIDIA has historically underpromised and overdelivered

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **China revenue upside**: If geopolitical conditions shift or China revenue restrictions are lifted/relaxed, this could add significant upside ($2–5B+ range)
- **Strong momentum**: If Q2 FY2027 results beat by a wide margin, confidence for Q3 guidance could be higher
- **Bank of America's thesis**: The $107–108 billion range suggests some analysts expect NVIDIA to guide more aggressively
- **AI acceleration**: Continued acceleration in data center demand and deployment could justify higher guidance
- **Competitive win**: Significant market share gains vs. AMD/custom chips could support higher numbers

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

**From the research provided:**
- Q2 FY2027 NVIDIA guidance (issued May 20, 2026): $91.0B ±2% ($89.2B–$92.8B)
- Q2 FY2027 Wall Street consensus: $91.9–$92.07B (41–42 analyst estimates)
- Q3 FY2027 consensus estimate: $103.8B
- Q3 FY2027 Bank of America estimate: $107–108B
- Sequential add embedded in consensus: $11.7B from Q2 to Q3

**Pattern observation**: Wall Street's consensus for Q3 ($103.8B) is significantly higher than Bank of America's bullish case ($107–108B), but lower than what might represent maximum upside.

---

## Reasoning toward point estimate

The range given (99.5–115.5B) brackets reasonable outcomes. Given:

1. **Consensus is $103.8B** for Q3 guidance—this is well within the range and represents ~42 analyst estimates
2. **NVIDIA typically guides conservatively** but the company has been increasingly confident given AI dominance
3. **Bank of America at $107–108B** represents the upper edge of reasonable expectations before reaching "very bullish" territory
4. **The $11.7B sequential add** from Q2 to Q3 is substantial but plausible given data center tailwinds
5. **China uncertainty** is explicitly noted as not included in current guidance; any change here could shift outcomes

The most probable outcome clusters around **$103–105B**, with meaningful probability mass extending to $106–108B if NVIDIA feels emboldened by results.

Lower tail risk (~99.5–101B) represents conservative/cautious scenarios. Upper tail risk (>110B) represents bullish China reopening or exceptional demand scenarios.

**Central estimate: $104.5B** (slightly above consensus, reflecting potential for NVIDIA to guide slightly higher than current Wall Street average, consistent with their recent pattern of confidence in the AI cycle, but still anchored to the broad consensus range).

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is set to announce its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the US market close, with the analyst call following at 2 p.m. PT [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, is revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, creating a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026) [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance explicitly "is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China" [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/) [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026) [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

Wall Street analysts, based on 41-42 estimates, generally forecast Q2 FY2027 revenue slightly higher, with an average estimate around $91.9 billion to $92.07 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/) [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/) [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). Some more bullish estimates from Bank of America are already suggesting $94–95 billion for Q2 [streetsignal.substack.com](https://streetsignal.substack.com/p/nvda-earnings-bridge).

The consensus for Q3 FY2027 revenue (the forward guidance to be given) is $103.8 billion, representing an $11.7 billion sequential add [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). Bank of America is forecasting even higher, at $107–108 billion for the Q3 guide [streetsignal.substack.com](https://streetsignal.substack.com/p/nvda-earnings-bridge).
